notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; business-type activities on the accrual basis (both the government-wide Statement of Activities and the proprietary statements). Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances Total Governmental Funds column (p5); fund-balance roll-forward 1,746,360 -> 1,692,044. Beginning governmental cash not printed (no prior-year balance sheet), so beginning_cash null; ending_cash = Cash and cash equivalents 1,675,294 (p4, includes restricted cash 827,693 shown on the government-wide statement); County treasurer cash 12,616 is a separate line (not added); certificates of deposit 4,134 in ending_investments. Business-type lines from the proprietary funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total column (p9), as in FY2024: operating revenues 2,491,211 + nonoperating interest 30,613 and franchise fees 60,000 (reported receipts total = their sum, no single total printed), operating expenses by cost type 2,446,073 + interest expense 40,604 = 2,486,677 (= Statement of Activities business-type expenses p2), transfers from other funds 57,350, net position 6,158,358 -> 6,310,855. Utility 'Other revenue' 51,846 is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities (p2), so charges for services. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (totals equal the government-wide governmental column 1,692,044), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position business-type column; totals from the Total column. Detail: General Fund taken from the departmental combining statement (p15-16, more detailed), so the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p12) is not recorded; Street Fund budget schedule (p13); nonmajor funds by column (p14; Grant Fund has no activity); enterprise funds have no supplementary schedule, so no enterprise detail (as FY2024; proprietary statement fund-column lines removed). Departmental transfers (in 77,686 / out 129,846, net -52,160) recorded as printed. Read pages 1-16 of 16
